# TftpdR 0.1.0

First public release: a read-only TFTP (RFC 1350) server, with a headless
daemon and a native [Slint](https://slint.dev/) desktop panel.

**中文摘要**：首个公开版本。只读 TFTP 服务端 + 无头 daemon + Slint 桌面面板；
不支持上传、GUI/daemon IPC 与 Windows 服务注册。

## Downloads

| Platform | Archive |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.1.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Windows arm64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.1.0-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Linux x86_64 (glibc) | `tftpd-r-0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 (glibc) | `tftpd-r-0.1.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |

Every archive contains `tftpd-r` (headless daemon), `tftpd-r-gui` (desktop
panel), `config.example.toml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`.
`SHA256SUMS` covers all assets in this release.

## What works

- RFC 1350 RRQ (read) transfers over UDP, one TID socket per session.
- RFC 2347/2348/2349 option negotiation: `blksize`, `timeout`, `tsize`; `octet`
  only, with explicit rejection of `netascii`/`mail` instead of silent fallback.
- Block-number wraparound, zero-length final block for exact multiples, bounded
  retransmission, duplicate-ACK tolerance and duplicate-RRQ resend without a
  second session.
- Component-wise path sandbox: traversal, drive letters, NTFS alternate data
  streams, Windows device names and reparse points are rejected; a legacy leading
  `/` is mapped to the configured root.
- Headless daemon CLI: `serve`, `check-config`, `print-default-config`, TOML
  configuration and graceful Ctrl-C / Ctrl-Break shutdown.
- Slint panel (embedded server): start/stop/restart, service-status chip,
  activity log, live transfer table, validated settings, About dialog and a
  recently-used root selector.

## Not included (deliberate)

- WRQ uploads: the server answers with ERROR 2 and `allow_upload = true` is a
  configuration error. `netascii` is rejected.
- GUI/daemon IPC (the GUI embeds the server in its own process), Windows Service
  registration, system tray, auto-update, remote management.

## Verification status

Verified by hand on Windows 11 with Rust 1.100.0 `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`:
105 tests pass, `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and
`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean, the release
build succeeds, and the GUI `--smoke-test` exits with 0. The panel's
start/stop/restart, a real 2 MiB TFTP transfer, settings/About dialogs, the
recent-root selector and the custom window controls were checked manually.

These artifacts are produced by CI. The `x86_64` archives are built on the same
runners that also pass the full test suite (MSVC on Windows, GNU on Linux), so
those two toolchains are known to compile and pass the tests. The `aarch64`
archives are built natively on arm64 runners, but no test suite was executed
there and no binary from this release was run by hand on any machine. In
addition, **nothing below has been verified** and is not claimed by this
release:

- running the GUI or daemon on a Linux desktop, or any `aarch64` binary anywhere;
- interoperability with real or legacy external TFTP clients, LAN/`0.0.0.0`
  operation, firewall rules for TID ports, and binding port 69;
- RDP sessions, real keyboard/IME input, screen readers, and rendering at other
  DPIs, locales or font stacks.

Linux binaries link the glibc of the CI runner (`ubuntu-latest`); build from
source on older distributions. The GUI needs an X11/Wayland session at runtime;
the daemon does not.

## Checksums

`SHA256SUMS` is attached to this release; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`
or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.
